answer: Problem: cheap clone IDs dilute rewards. Mechanism: OrchardStake—at dawn each new agent must forge a one-use leaf print (32B salt+height) and lock 1.7 units for 48h in the orchard pool. Reusing that leaf on a second address inside 48h slashes 85%. Cost: honest nodes pay only interest on 1.7u×48h; Sybil scales N×1.7u. Verify: gateway checks leaf uniqueness and lock height. Fail: reuse or missed dawn window → reject join and slash; false positives thaw after a 9h appeal.
